com.google.android.material.button.Mater.android:contentDescription: Push to talk. Touch and hold to talk; your microphone is muted when you let go.

TextView.tools:text: Fills the screen without stretching; excess edges are cropped.
Off (recommended): this phone tunes buffering, link rate and encoder speed from measurements.
Aims for predictable radio load; quality can vary when motion changes.
Camera input: direct surface\nNative sizes: 12 (176×144 to 3840×2160)\nFPS: 15 / 24 / 30

com.google.android.material.materialswit.android:text: Experimental: temporal layering (may drop enhancement frames under congestion)

TextView.android:text: Off by default. While a Bluetooth link is tight, every other frame is made droppable and slow links may skip those frames instead of building delay. Costs picture quality; applies to streams started after it is changed.

com.google.android.material.materialswit.android:text: Relay: slow viewers skip to keyframes

TextView.android:text: On by default. When this phone forwards a stream and the next phone's link is slower than the stream, that phone skips old video to the next keyframe while its sound continues. Off: nothing is skipped and a viewer that falls too far behind is disconnected so it can find another route. Applies to forwarding started after it is changed.

Off by default. Tapping a person asks Voice call or Video call. A voice call starts no camera and sends no video, uses the earpiece, and either person can add or remove their own video during the call. Phones without this option see a video call with your video off.
Off by default. Hold the button to talk; your microphone is muted when you let go. PTT mode starts every call muted. Applies to calls started after it is changed.

Off by default. Adds Messages: end-to-end encrypted text, voice notes and photos for contacts whose card you hold. Messages wait on this phone and move when both phones have Call open and one taps the other and chooses Exchange messages. A call pauses an exchange. Only direct neighbours for now; no other phone carries your messages.

com.google.android.material.materialswit.android:text: Experimental: automatic BLE GATT when L2CAP fails

TextView.android:text: Off by default. Some phones stop accepting L2CAP connections after about 15 uses until Bluetooth restarts. When it is on and L2CAP fails, or this Bluetooth session has used the set number of L2CAP registrations (12 by default), calls use BLE GATT and say so. Phones advertising GATT also appear in the call list.

Off by default. Turn it on in both phones. Classic calls, relays and streams then work without Android pairing: the app's own signed handshake and encryption protect the link, and each phone remembers the Classic address of a phone it has met. A first call to a phone this phone has never met needs that phone to be visible, so a phone ready for Classic calls may ask Android to make it visible for two minutes. Streams use only phones already met.

Off by default. Searches also look for the short announcement an iPhone can send while its app is open, so iPhone callers, viewers and streams can appear in the lists. This phone's own announcement and every security check stay the same. An iPhone whose app is in the background cannot be found.

Off by default. Adds Share app nearby to Help: this phone starts its own Wi-Fi Direct network and a download page, and shows two codes another phone scans to join it and download the app, without internet. It stops after 10 minutes or when you leave that screen, and it cannot start during a stream or call because Wi-Fi Direct slows Bluetooth.
